description: This file contains extension methods for the OrchardCore.Media module, providing URL generation and image resizing functionalities for media assets within OrchardCore CMS, including support for media profiles and tokenized URLs.

classes.name: MediaOrchardRazorHelperExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for URL generation and image resizing in OrchardCore Media.

methods.name: AssetUrl
methods.description: Generates a relative URL for a media asset with optional resizing and versioning.

methods.name: AssetProfileUrlAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a URL for a media asset with a specific media profile and optional resizing.

methods.name: ImageResizeUrl
methods.description: Creates a URL for an image with custom resizing parameters.

methods.name: ImageProfileResizeUrlAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a URL for an image with a media profile and resizing parameters.

methods.name: TokenizeUrl
methods.description: Appends a token to the URL if tokenized query strings are enabled in media options.
